## Business Overview
JobSphere is a job search platform that sells a sense of purpose and fulfillment to its users. The ideal customer is a highly motivated and ambitious individual looking for a career that aligns with their values and goals. JobSphere sits in a competitive market, but its unique selling proposition lies in its ability to connect top talent with verified companies, offering salary transparency and a global reach.
